content.summary: CDT Environmental Technology Investment Holdings Limited ( (CDTG) ) has provided an update. Despite the challenging market conditions, the company maintained a stable core revenue and a gross margin of 35.5%, aided by cost reduction initiatives and restructuring efforts.
